migrated.turkish: Rabbimiz! Kendimize zulmettik. Bizi bağışlamaz ve bize merhamet etmezsen, kaybedenlerden oluruz.
migrated.transliteration: Rabbana zalamna anfusana wa in lam taghfir lana wa tarhamna lanakunna mina al-khasirin.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (7:23), Adam and Hawwa turn to Allah, admitting their wrong and asking for forgiveness and mercy.
migrated.reflection: Use this dua to own mistakes and ask Allah’s mercy without excuses.

migrated.turkish: Rabbim! Beni, anne babamı, evime mümin olarak girenleri ve tüm mümin erkekleri ile mümin kadınları bağışla; zalimlerin helakini artır.
migrated.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir li wa liwalidayya wa liman dakhala baytiya mu'minan wa lil-mu'minina wal-mu'minat wa la tazid al-zalimin illa tabara.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (71:28), Nuh prays for forgiveness for himself, his parents, and all believing men and women.
migrated.reflection: Include family and the wider ummah in your prayers for forgiveness.

migrated.turkish: Rabbim! Beni bereketli bir menzile indir. Sen indirenlerin en hayırlısısın.
migrated.transliteration: Rabbi anzilni munzalan mubarakan wa anta khayru al-munzilin.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (23:29), Nuh asks for a blessed landing after being saved.
migrated.reflection: Ask Allah’s blessing when entering a new phase or place.

migrated.turkish: Rabbim! Bilmediğim şeyi Senden istemekten Sana sığınırım. Beni bağışlamaz ve bana merhamet etmezsen kaybedenlerden olurum.
migrated.transliteration: Rabbi inni a'udhu bika an as'alaka ma laysa li bihi ilm wa illa taghfir li wa tarhamni akun mina al-khasirin.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (11:47), Nuh seeks refuge after being corrected and asks for Allah’s forgiveness and mercy.
migrated.reflection: Accept correction with humility and return to Allah.

migrated.turkish: Rabbim! Yeryüzünde inkârcılardan tek bir kimseyi bırakma.
migrated.transliteration: Rabbi la tadhar 'ala al-ardi mina al-kafirina dayyara.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (71:26), Nuh asks Allah to end persistent disbelief and corruption.
migrated.reflection: When oppression persists, ask Allah to establish justice while staying patient.

migrated.turkish: Rabbim! Burasını güvenli bir belde yap ve Allah’a ve ahiret gününe iman eden halkını meyvelerle rızıklandır.
migrated.transliteration: Rabbi ij'al hadha baladan amina warzuq ahlahu mina al-thamarat man amana minhum billahi wal-yawm al-akhir.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (2:126), Ibrahim prays for a secure city and provision for its believing people.
migrated.reflection: Pray for safety and lawful provision for your community.

migrated.turkish: Rabbimiz! Bizden kabul buyur; şüphesiz Sen işiten ve bilensin.
migrated.transliteration: Rabbana taqabbal minna innaka anta al-sami'u al-'alim.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (2:127), Ibrahim and Ismail ask Allah to accept their service while raising the Ka‘bah.
migrated.reflection: Seek Allah’s acceptance for every act of worship.

migrated.turkish: Rabbim! Bu beldeyi güvenli kıl; beni ve çocuklarımı putlara tapmaktan uzak tut.
migrated.transliteration: Rabbi ij'al hadha al-balad amina wajnubni wa baniyya an na'bud al-asnam.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (14:35), Ibrahim asks Allah to secure the city and protect his family from idolatry.
migrated.reflection: Ask Allah to safeguard faith for yourself and your family.

migrated.turkish: Rabbim! Putlar birçok insanı saptırdı. Kim bana uyarsa bendendir; kim bana karşı gelirse, şüphesiz Sen bağışlayan ve merhamet edensin.
migrated.transliteration: Rabbi innahunna adlalna kathiran mina al-nas fa man tabi'ani fa innahu minni wa man 'asani fa innaka ghafur rahim.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (14:36), Ibrahim acknowledges the misguidance of idols and entrusts people to Allah’s mercy.
migrated.reflection: Hold to truth while relying on Allah’s mercy for others.

migrated.turkish: Rabbim! Bana hikmet ver ve beni salihlerle birlikte kıl.
migrated.transliteration: Rabbi hab li hukman wa alhiqni bil-salihin.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (26:83), Ibrahim asks for sound judgment and to be joined with the righteous.
migrated.reflection: Seek wisdom and righteous company to stay on the right path.

migrated.turkish: Rabbim! Bana salih bir evlat bağışla.
migrated.transliteration: Rabbi hab li mina al-salihin.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (37:100), Ibrahim asks Allah to grant him a righteous child.
migrated.reflection: Ask for children who bring you closer to Allah.

migrated.turkish: Rabbim! Beni ve ailemi onların yaptıklarından kurtar.
migrated.transliteration: Rabbi najjini wa ahli mimma ya'malun.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (26:169), Lut asks Allah to save him and his family from what his people do.
migrated.reflection: Seek Allah’s protection for your family amid harmful surroundings.

migrated.turkish: Rabbim! Bana hüküm verdin ve rüya yorumunu öğrettin. Göklerin ve yerin yaratıcısı! Dünyada da ahirette de dostum Sensin. Beni Müslüman olarak vefat ettir ve beni salihlerle birlikte kıl.
migrated.transliteration: Rabbi qad ataytani mina al-mulk wa 'allamtani min ta'wil al-ahadith fatir al-samawati wal-ard anta waliyyi fi al-dunya wal-akhirah tawaffani musliman wa alhiqni bil-salihin.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (12:101), Yusuf thanks Allah for authority and knowledge and asks for a faithful end.
migrated.reflection: Let blessings lead you to gratitude and a righteous conclusion.

migrated.turkish: Bana sıkıntı dokundu; Sen merhametlilerin en merhametlisisin.
migrated.transliteration: Anni massaniya al-durru wa anta arham al-rahimin.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (21:83), Ayyub mentions his hardship and appeals to Allah’s mercy.
migrated.reflection: When tested, speak to Allah with humility and hope.

migrated.turkish: Rabbim! Şeytan bana yorgunluk ve azap dokundurdu.
migrated.transliteration: Rabbi inni massaniya al-shaytanu binusbin wa 'adhab.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (38:41), Ayyub describes his suffering and turns to Allah for help.
migrated.reflection: Present your hardship to Allah and seek His relief.

migrated.turkish: Rabbim! Gönlümü genişlet.
migrated.transliteration: Rabbi ishrah li sadri.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (20:25), Musa begins his supplication by asking Allah to expand his chest.
migrated.reflection: Ask Allah for inner strength when carrying responsibility.

migrated.turkish: Rabbim! Kendime zulmettim, beni bağışla. Allah onu bağışladı; şüphesiz O çok bağışlayan, çok merhamet edendir.
migrated.transliteration: Rabbi inni zalamtu nafsi faghfir li faghafara lahu innahu huwa al-ghafur al-rahim.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (28:16), Musa admits his wrongdoing and asks Allah’s forgiveness.
migrated.reflection: Admit mistakes quickly and seek Allah’s pardon.

migrated.turkish: Rabbim! Beni zalim topluluktan kurtar.
migrated.transliteration: Rabbi najjini mina al-qawmi al-zalimin.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (28:21), Musa asks to be saved from wrongdoing people.
migrated.reflection: Seek Allah’s protection when facing injustice.

migrated.turkish: Rabbim! Bana indireceğin her türlü hayra muhtacım.
migrated.transliteration: Rabbi inni lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqir.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (28:24), Musa asks for any good that Allah sends down.
migrated.reflection: Recognize your dependence on Allah’s provision.

migrated.turkish: Rabbim! Beni ve kardeşimi bağışla; bizi rahmetine dahil et. Sen merhametlilerin en merhametlisisin.
migrated.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir li wa li akhi wa adkhilna fi rahmatika wa anta arham al-rahimin.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (7:151), Musa asks forgiveness for himself and his brother and seeks Allah’s mercy.
migrated.reflection: Ask Allah’s mercy for yourself and those you love.

migrated.turkish: Bu dünyada da ahirette de bize güzellik yaz; biz Sana yöneldik.
migrated.transliteration: Waktub lana fi hadhihi al-dunya hasanatan wa fi al-akhirati inna hudna ilayk.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (7:156), Musa asks for goodness in this life and the Hereafter while turning to Allah.
migrated.reflection: Balance worldly needs with hope for the Hereafter.

migrated.turkish: Rabbimiz! Firavun’a ve ileri gelenlerine dünya hayatında süs ve mal verdin; böylece Senin yolundan saptırıyorlar. Rabbimiz! Mallarını yok et, kalplerini sıkılaştır ki acı azabı görmedikçe iman etmesinler.
migrated.transliteration: Rabbana innaka atayta fir'awna wa mala'ahu zinatan wa amwalan fi al-hayat al-dunya rabbana liyudillu 'an sabilika rabbana itmis 'ala amwalihim wa ushdud 'ala qulubihim fala yu'minu hatta yaraw al-'adhab al-alim.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (10:88), Musa and Harun ask Allah to restrain Pharaoh’s misguidance and oppression.
migrated.reflection: Ask Allah to end wrongdoing and protect people from being led astray.

migrated.turkish: Rabbim! Bana ve anne babama verdiğin nimetlere şükretmeyi ve razı olacağın salih ameller yapmayı nasip et. Soyumu ıslah et. Sana yöneldim ve Müslümanlardanım.
migrated.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'ni an ashkura ni'mataka allati an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala walidayya wa an a'mala salihan tardah wa aslih li fi dhurriyyati inni tubtu ilayka wa inni mina al-muslimin.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (27:19), Sulaiman asks to be grateful and to do deeds pleasing to Allah.
migrated.reflection: Pair gratitude with action that Allah loves.

migrated.turkish: Rabbim! Beni bağışla ve benden sonra kimseye verilmeyecek bir hüküm ver. Sen çok vericisin.
migrated.transliteration: Rabbi ighfir li wa hab li mulkan la yanbaghi li ahadin min ba'di innaka anta al-wahhab.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (38:35), Sulaiman asks forgiveness and a unique kingdom by Allah’s gift.
migrated.reflection: Seek Allah’s forgiveness even when granted power.

migrated.turkish: Rabbim! Bana katından temiz bir nesil bağışla; Sen duayı işitensin.
migrated.transliteration: Rabbi hab li min ladunka dhurriyyatan tayyibatan innaka sami'u al-du'a.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (3:38), Zakariya asks Allah for good offspring.
migrated.reflection: Ask Allah for righteous family and trust His timing.

migrated.turkish: Katından bana bir veli bağışla.
migrated.transliteration: Fahab li min ladunka waliyyan.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (19:5), Zakariya asks for a successor from Allah.
migrated.reflection: Pray for successors who preserve faith.

migrated.turkish: Rabbim! Beni tek başıma bırakma; Sen varislerin en hayırlısısın.
migrated.transliteration: Rabbi la tadharni fardan wa anta khayru al-warithin.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (21:89), Zakariya asks not to be left without an heir.
migrated.reflection: Bring your deepest hopes to Allah with patience.

migrated.turkish: Senden başka ilah yok; Seni her türlü eksiklikten tenzih ederim. Ben zalimlerden oldum.
migrated.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu mina al-zalimin.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (21:87), Yunus calls upon Allah, affirming tawhid and admitting his wrongdoing.
migrated.reflection: In distress, return to Allah with tawhid and repentance.

migrated.turkish: Allah’ım, Rabbimiz! Gökten bize bir sofra indir; bize bayram olsun ve Senden bir ayet olsun. Bizi rızıklandır; Sen rızık verenlerin en hayırlısısın.
migrated.transliteration: Allahumma rabbana anzil 'alayna ma'idatan mina al-sama'i takunu lana 'idan li-awwalina wa akhirina wa ayatan minka warzuqna wa anta khayru al-raziqin.
migrated.context: In the Qur’an (5:114), Isa supplicates for a table from heaven as a sign and provision.
migrated.reflection: Ask Allah for provision with gratitude and awareness of His signs.

orphaned.turkish: Rabbim! Beni yalanlamalarına karşı bana yardım et.
orphaned.context: In the Qur’an (23:26), Nuh asks Allah for help against those who denied his message.
orphaned.reflection: Seek Allah’s help when facing rejection for truth.

orphaned.turkish: Rabbimiz! Bizi Sana teslim olanlardan kıl; soyumuzdan da Sana teslim bir ümmet çıkar. Bize ibadet yollarımızı göster ve tövbemizi kabul et.
orphaned.transliteration: Rabbana waj'alna muslimayni laka wa min dhurriyyatina ummatan muslimatan laka wa arina manasikana wa tub 'alayna innaka anta al-tawwab al-rahim.
orphaned.context: In the Qur’an (2:128), Ibrahim and Ismail ask for steadfast submission and guidance in worship.
orphaned.reflection: Ask Allah to keep your worship sincere and guide your family.

orphaned.turkish: Rabbimiz! Onların arasına kendilerinden bir elçi gönder; ayetlerini okusun, Kitabı ve hikmeti öğretsin, onları arındırsın.
orphaned.transliteration: Rabbana wab'ath fihim rasulan minhum yatlu 'alayhim ayatika wa yu'allimuhum al-kitab wal-hikmah wa yuzakkihim innaka anta al-'aziz al-hakim.
orphaned.context: In the Qur’an (2:129), Ibrahim asks for a messenger to teach and purify his descendants.
orphaned.reflection: True guidance comes through revelation and teaching—ask Allah for it.

orphaned.turkish: Rabbimiz! Soyumdan bir kısmını, namazı dosdoğru kılsınlar diye Beyt-i Haram’ın yanında ekinsiz bir vadiye yerleştirdim. İnsanların kalplerini onlara yönelt ve onları meyvelerle rızıklandır ki şükretsinler.
orphaned.transliteration: Rabbana inni askantu min dhurriyyati biwadin ghayri dhi zar'in 'inda baytika al-muharram rabbana liyuqimu al-salah faj'al af'idatan mina al-nas tahwi ilayhim warzuqhum mina al-thamarat la'allahum yashkurun.
orphaned.context: In the Qur’an (14:37), Ibrahim mentions settling his descendants near the Sacred House and prays for hearts and provision.
orphaned.reflection: Communities need both devotion and provision—ask Allah for both.

orphaned.turkish: Rabbim! Beni namazı dosdoğru kılanlardan eyle; soyumdan da. Rabbimiz, duamı kabul buyur.
orphaned.transliteration: Rabbi ij'alni muqima al-salah wa min dhurriyyati rabbana wa taqabbal du'a.
orphaned.context: In the Qur’an (14:40), Ibrahim asks to be steadfast in prayer and for his descendants to do the same.
orphaned.reflection: Ask Allah to make prayer consistent across generations.

orphaned.turkish: Rabbimiz! Hesap görüleceği gün beni, anne babamı ve müminleri bağışla.
orphaned.transliteration: Rabbana ighfir li wa liwalidayya wa lil-mu'minina yawma yaqumu al-hisab.
orphaned.context: In the Qur’an (14:41), Ibrahim asks forgiveness for himself, his parents, and the believers on the Day of Account.
orphaned.reflection: Remember the Hereafter and include others in your prayers.

orphaned.turkish: Sonraki nesiller arasında benim için doğru bir ün nasip et.
orphaned.transliteration: Waj'al li lisan sidqin fi al-akhirin.
orphaned.context: In the Qur’an (26:84), Ibrahim asks for a truthful reputation among later generations.
orphaned.reflection: Aim for a legacy of truthfulness, not fame.

orphaned.context: In the Qur’an (26:85), Ibrahim asks to be among the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss.
orphaned.reflection: Let your goals be anchored in the Hereafter.

orphaned.transliteration: Waghfir li abi innahu kana mina al-dallin.
orphaned.context: In the Qur’an (26:86), Ibrahim asks forgiveness for his father.
orphaned.reflection: Pray for your family with compassion while staying within Allah’s guidance.

orphaned.context: In the Qur’an (26:87), Ibrahim asks not to be disgraced on the Day of Resurrection.
orphaned.reflection: Ask Allah for honor and safety on the Day of Judgment.

orphaned.context: In the Qur’an (20:26), Musa asks Allah to make his task easy.
orphaned.reflection: Turn to Allah for ease in difficult duties.

orphaned.context: In the Qur’an (20:27), Musa asks for clarity of speech.
orphaned.reflection: Seek Allah’s help to communicate truth clearly.

orphaned.context: In the Qur’an (20:28), Musa asks that his speech be understood.
orphaned.reflection: Pray that your message is received with understanding.

orphaned.turkish: Allah’ım! Kendime çok zulmettim; günahları ancak Sen bağışlarsın. Beni bağışla ve bana merhamet et; Sen çok bağışlayan, çok merhamet edensin.
orphaned.transliteration: Allahumma inni zalamtu nafsi zulman kathiran wa la yaghfiru al-dhunuba illa anta faghfir li maghfiratan min 'indika warhamni innaka anta al-ghafur al-rahim.
orphaned.context: In Sahih al-Bukhari (834), the Prophet ﷺ taught Abu Bakr to say this in prayer when seeking forgiveness and mercy.
orphaned.reflection: Use this dua in prayer when asking Allah for sincere forgiveness.

orphaned.turkish: Allah’ım! Cehennem azabından, kabir azabından, hayat ve ölüm fitnelerinden ve Deccal fitnesinin şerrinden Sana sığınırım.
orphaned.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhabi jahannam wa min 'adhabi al-qabr wa min fitnati al-mahya wal-mamat wa min sharri fitnati al-masih al-dajjal.
orphaned.context: In Sahih Muslim (843), the Prophet ﷺ instructed this supplication for protection from major trials and punishments in prayer.
orphaned.reflection: Recite it to seek Allah’s protection from unseen and future trials.

orphaned.turkish: Allah’ım! İşlerimin teminatı olan dinimi düzelt; geçimimin olduğu dünyamı düzelt; dönüşümün olduğu ahiretimi de düzelt.
orphaned.transliteration: Allahumma aslih li diniya alladhi huwa 'ismatu amri wa aslih li dunyaya allati fiha ma'ashi wa aslih li akhirati allati fiha ma'adi.
orphaned.context: In Sahih Muslim (2720), it is reported that the Prophet ﷺ would supplicate for rectification of religion, worldly life, and the Hereafter.
orphaned.reflection: Ask Allah to set right all dimensions of life, not just one.

orphaned.turkish: Allah’ım! Senden hidayet, takva, iffet ve gönül zenginliği dilerim.
orphaned.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka al-huda wa al-tuqa wa al-'afaf wa al-ghina.
orphaned.context: In Sahih Muslim (2721), it is reported that the Prophet ﷺ would ask for guidance, piety, chastity, and contentment.
orphaned.reflection: Prioritize inner character alongside material needs.

orphaned.turkish: Allah’ım! Hüzün ve kederden, acizlik ve tembellikten, cimrilik ve korkaklıktan, borç yükünden ve insanların baskısından Sana sığınırım.
orphaned.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-hamm wal-hazan wal-'ajz wal-kasal wal-bukhl wal-jubn wa dala' al-dayn wa ghalabat al-rijal.
orphaned.context: In Sahih al-Bukhari (6369), it is reported that the Prophet ﷺ would seek refuge from anxiety, laziness, and overpowering debt.
orphaned.reflection: Seek Allah’s refuge from inner burdens and social pressures.
